description: Deferred read error-number reporting is incomplete: CUDA never assigns the captured number, while CPU captures it but never reports it.
trigger: A read, seek or CUDA-copy failure reaches stloader_deferred_cuda's worker error label and subsequently reaches its post-join failure check.
expected_behavior: The diagnostic should preserve the relevant failure information rather than present zero as the captured error number.
actual_behavior: load_errnum is initialized to zero and never assigned in this function; the worker sets only load_failed, so the new exception formats strerror(0) and errno=0. The deferred CPU worker captures errno, but its post-join check retains the generic I/O-error text; the approved reviewer groups both halves as one oversight.

verification.description: Compared the complete parent function with the task diff. Whole-parent-tree literal caller search found the Python invocation in SafetensorsCollection.end_deferred_load and the native binding; the inspected caller passes CUDA workloads to this function. The observation therefore concerns deferred CUDA loads, not every get_tensor call.
verification.limits: No failure was induced; native exception propagation and runtime error text were not tested.
